title: Estimator forensics for the wide-binary gravity test: corrected Gaia DR3 application
description: Corrected reproducibility release. Versions 1-2 incorrectly treated Chae's 81,088-row virtual Newtonian catalogue as observational Gaia DR3 data. The affected observational gravity claims are withdrawn. This release provides a provenance audit, a checksum-verified loader for the 81,880-row real corrected-RUWE catalogue, a corrected model-dependent/non-conclusive Gaia DR3 analysis, and the surviving known-truth injection-recovery experiment.
